nm:output.nm:control_stream:
$PROBLEM TMDD (QSS) | tmdd rep08 | FOCEI $ABBR DERIV2=NO $INPUT ID TIME AMT DV MDV EVID CMT DVID $DATA data.csv IGNORE=@ $SUBROUTINES ADVAN13 TOL=3 ATOL=6 $MODEL COMP=(ATOT,DEFDOSE,DEFOBS) COMP=(PERIPH) COMP=(RTOT)
$PK ; individual parameters: theta_i = exp(MU + ETA), MU = log(typical value) [+ covariate effects]; ; parameters without IIV have an ETA with OMEGA 0 FIX (MU referencing for FOCE FAST) MU_1 = LOG(THETA(1)) CL = EXP(MU_1 + ETA(1)) MU_2 = LOG(THETA(2)) V1 = EXP(MU_2 + ETA(2)) MU_3 = LOG(THETA(3)) Q = EXP(MU_3 + ETA(3)) MU_4 = LOG(THETA(4)) V2 = EXP(MU_4 + ETA(4)) MU_5 = LOG(THETA(5)) RBASE = EXP(MU_5 + ETA(5)) MU_6 = LOG(THETA(6)) KDEG = EXP(MU_6 + ETA(6)) MU_7 = LOG(THETA(7)) KINT = EXP(MU_7 + ETA(7)) MU_8 = LOG(THETA(8)) KSS = EXP(MU_8 + ETA(8)) A_0(3) = RBASE
$DES CTOT = A(1)/V1 DQ = CTOT - A(3) - KSS CF = 0.5*(DQ + SQRT(DQ*DQ + 4*KSS*CTOT)) OCC = A(3)*CF/(KSS + CF) DADT(1) = -CL*CF - Q*CF + Q*A(2)/V2 - KINT*V1*OCC DADT(2) = Q*CF - Q*A(2)/V2 DADT(3) = KDEG*RBASE - KDEG*A(3) - (KINT - KDEG)*OCC
$ERROR CTOTE = A(1)/V1 DQE = CTOTE - A(3) - KSS CFE = 0.5*(DQE + SQRT(DQE*DQE + 4*KSS*CTOTE)) IPRED = CFE IF (DVID.EQ.2) IPRED = A(3) Y = IPRED + IPRED*EPS(1) IF (DVID.EQ.2) Y = IPRED + IPRED*EPS(2)
$THETA (0, 0.28) ; 1 Cl_pop (0, 2.1) ; 2 V1_pop (0, 0.75) ; 3 Q_pop (0, 1.75) ; 4 V2_pop (0, 14.0) ; 5 R0_pop (0, 0.35) ; 6 kdeg_pop (0, 0.075) ; 7 kint_pop (0, 0.6) ; 8 KSS_pop
$OMEGA 0.25 ; ETA(1) Cl (omega = 0.5) 0.25 ; ETA(2) V1 (omega = 0.5) 0 FIX ; ETA(3) Q (no IIV) 0.25 ; ETA(4) V2 (omega = 0.5) 0.25 ; ETA(5) R0 (omega = 0.5) 0 FIX ; ETA(6) kdeg (no IIV) 0 FIX ; ETA(7) kint (no IIV) 0 FIX ; ETA(8) KSS (no IIV)
$SIGMA 0.09 ; EPS(1) Free proportional (b1 = 0.3) 0.09 ; EPS(2) Target proportional (b2 = 0.3)
; -2LL: importance sampling (EONLY=1), proposal t with 5 df; first IMP adapts the proposal, ; the second evaluates with 10000 samples per individual (as Monolix). Reported value: ; 'OBJECTIVE FUNCTION VALUE WITH CONSTANT' of the last step. $EST METHOD=COND INTERACTION FAST MAXEVAL=9999 NSIG=1 SIGL=3 PRINT=5 NOABORT FORMAT=s1PE17.10 $EST METHOD=IMP INTERACTION EONLY=1 NITER=5 ISAMPLE=1000 DF=5 ISCALE_MIN=1 ISCALE_MAX=1 MAPITER=0 CTYPE=0 SIGL=3 PRINT=1 SEED=23456 NOCOV=1 FORMAT=s1PE17.10 $EST METHOD=IMP INTERACTION EONLY=1 NITER=1 ISAMPLE=10000 DF=5 ISCALE_MIN=1 ISCALE_MAX=1 MAPITER=0 CTYPE=0 SIGL=3 PRINT=1 SEED=34567 NOCOV=1 FNLETA=0
